subject: gk
question: Which of the following is the correct pair of autobiography and its autobiographer?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mein Kampf: Adolf Hitler**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• *Mein Kampf* was written by Adolf Hitler, the leader of Nazi Germany.
 
• Hitler wrote *Mein Kampf* while he was imprisoned after a failed coup attempt in 1923 known as the Beer Hall Putsch.
 
• He was sentenced to prison for his role in the coup, which aimed to overthrow the Weimar government.
 
• Time Period: The book was written between 1924 and 1925 during his time in Landsberg Prison, and the first volume was published in 1925, followed by a second volume in 1926.
 
• Hence this pair is correct

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Long Walk to Freedom: Malcolm 

 
 
• Incorrect: *Long Walk to Freedom* is the autobiography of Nelson Mandela, not Malcolm (likely referring to Malcolm X).
 
 
 
• On Writing: Ernest Hemingway
 
 
• Incorrect: *On Writing* is the memoir of Stephen King, not Ernest Hemingway.
 
 
 
• Open: Anne Frank
 
 
• Incorrect: *Open* is the autobiography of Andre Agassi, the tennis player, not Anne Frank. Anne Frank is known for her diary *The Diary of a Young Girl*.
